requirements.text: Pontis 5.0 shall provide a repository for bridge data, including inventory, condition, needs, project plans, and accomplishments.
Pontis 5.0 shall support import and export of data in XML format based on the TransXML schema.
The system shall provide a web-based interface for selected modules and a dedicated client application for others.
The system shall allow users to select bridges and projects using various criteria including ID, location, and administrative attributes.
The system shall provide the ability to calculate NBI condition ratings, sufficiency ratings, and SD/FO status.
The system shall provide a project planning module to create, edit, and manage bridge work projects.
The system shall support the creation and management of user roles and permissions for security.
The system shall provide a mechanism for data validation and quality assurance on bridge inventory and inspection data.
The system shall be designed to support a repository capacity of at least 50,000 bridges.
The system shall provide a response time of 5-10 seconds for redisplaying the typical desktop for 250 bridges.
The system shall support Windows Authentication for database access.
The system shall support single-sign-on authentication based on Active Directory or LDAP standards.
The system shall provide an on-line help interface accessible throughout the user interface.
The system shall be designed such that routine users can become proficient after two hours of training.
The system shall not impose hard limits on the number of simultaneous users, relying instead on agency server capacity.
The system shall be developed using Microsoft .NET technologies and support Sybase, Oracle, and SQL Server databases.
